question: **The main idea of the passage is that:**

options.text: mangoes should be eaten in appropriate proportion
mango is one of the most popular fruits

solution:
The correct answer is: **mangoes should be eaten in appropriate proportion**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The second sentence of the last para in the given passage states that, ***"***____***Remember that mangoes, being high on sugars, predominantly fructose, should be consumed in appropriate portions."***__
 
• So, we can say The main idea of the passage is that, mangoes should be eaten in appropriate proportion.

​Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.
